questions.text_clean:
2. The volume $V$ of a cylinder of radius $R$ and height $H$ is given by $V=\pi R^2 H$. The volume of the cylinder was measured with an uncertainty of 10% and the height was measured with an uncertainty of 6%. What is the uncertainty in the radius of the cylinder?

B. 2%
C. 4%

questions.review_note: Official key D (8%). Fractional uncertainty: 10% = 2(dR/R) + 6% gives dR/R = 2% (option B). Key letter appears to be wrong; mcq_answer left as official.
